# OpenMemory Guide — Ultraterrestrial Resurrection

## Overview

UAP research platform monorepo: Next.js app (`apps/app`), disconnected Python RAG (`apps/disclosure-rag`), Neon Postgres via `@db/postgres` (`packages/db`).

## Architecture

- Research canvas → MindMap shell → ViewSwitcher → Graph / Timeline / Sightings / Search / Detail
- Live AI: disclosure mindmap agent + Prometheus chat
- Design: Microfilm Dark (`DESIGN.md`), vision docs in `docs/vision/`

## User Defined Namespaces

- frontend
- design

## Components

### OraclePanel

- **Path:** `apps/app/src/components/oracle-panel/`
- **Purpose:** Oracle Recipe panel — view/edit multi-step workflow, confirm & run, duplicate & re-run
- **Stories:** `Components/OraclePanel` (incl. InteractiveDemo)
- **Deps:** framer-motion, @dnd-kit, lucide-react, sonner

### OryzaeTimeline

- **Path:** `apps/app/src/components/oryzae-timeline/`
- **Purpose:** Dark floating-card memory timeline (CodePen port) — spine, range nav, dimmed memories
- **Stories:** `Components/OryzaeTimeline`
- **Fonts:** Inter + Noto Serif JP (injected via `useOryzaeFonts`)

### Cursor Research Subagents

- **Path:** `.cursor/agents/`
- **Purpose:** 18 project-scoped research specialists generated from the canonical v2 agent definitions
- **Scope:** Development-time Cursor subagents only; they do not add runtime product agents
- **Safety:** Shared epistemic contract, role authority, logical tool/write boundaries, handoffs, and output contracts are embedded in every agent
- **Generator:** `.cursor/generate-research-agents.mjs`
- **Excluded:** Restricted `DOTY_PATTERN` adversarial profile

## Patterns

- Feature/component folders: kebab-case dir, PascalCase components, co-located `.stories.tsx`
- Storybook demos that need state live as `*Demo.tsx` harnesses next to the component
- Design ports keep inline styles when matching source fidelity; extract tokens to `types` / constants

done

    print("HIT", c.get("id"), name)

'

file_blocks = re.findall(r'(?:^|\n)(?:file:\s*|//\s*File:\s*|###\s*)?(/?(?:app|components)/[^\n`]+\.tsx)\n```(?:tsx|typescript|ts)?\n([\s\S]*?)```', blob)
print('file_blocks', len(file_blocks))
for path, code in file_blocks:
    print(' ', path, len(code))

fenced = list(patterns[0].finditer(blob))
print('fenced', len(fenced))
for m in fenced[:30]:
    path = m.group(1) or m.group(2) or ''
    code = m.group(3)
    print(' fence', path or '(no path)', len(code), code[:60].replace('\n',' '))

# Look for "files" arrays in experimental content
for d in msgs:
    exp = d.get('experimental_content')
    def find_files(o, path='$'):
        if isinstance(o, dict):
            if 'name' in o and ('content' in o or 'source' in o) and str(o.get('name','')).endswith(('.tsx','.ts','.css')):
                yield o
            for k,v in o.items():
                yield from find_files(v, path+'.'+k)
        elif isinstance(o, list):
            for i,v in enumerate(o):
                yield from find_files(v, f'{path}[{i}]')
    files = list(find_files(exp))
    print(d.get('id')[:8], 'embedded files', len(files))
    for f in files:
        c = f.get('content') or f.get('source') or ''
        print(' ', f.get('name'), len(c), repr(c[:40]))
        if c and c.strip() not in ('GENERATING',):
            name = f.get('name').lstrip('/')
            dest = out/'src'/name
            dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            dest.write_text(c)

# OpenMemory Guide — Ultraterrestrial Resurrection

## Overview

UAP research platform monorepo: Next.js app (`apps/app`), disconnected Python RAG (`apps/disclosure-rag`), Neon Postgres via `@db/postgres` (`packages/db`).

## Architecture

- Research canvas → MindMap shell → ViewSwitcher → Graph / Timeline / Sightings / Search / Detail
- Live AI: disclosure mindmap agent + Prometheus chat
- Design: Microfilm Dark (`DESIGN.md`), vision docs in `docs/vision/`

## User Defined Namespaces

- frontend
- design

## Components

### OraclePanel

- **Path:** `apps/app/src/components/oracle-panel/`
- **Purpose:** Oracle Recipe panel — view/edit multi-step workflow, confirm & run, duplicate & re-run
- **Stories:** `Components/OraclePanel` (incl. InteractiveDemo)
- **Deps:** framer-motion, @dnd-kit, lucide-react, sonner

### OryzaeTimeline

- **Path:** `apps/app/src/components/oryzae-timeline/`
- **Purpose:** Dark floating-card memory timeline (CodePen port) — spine, range nav, dimmed memories
- **Stories:** `Components/OryzaeTimeline`
- **Fonts:** Inter + Noto Serif JP (injected via `useOryzaeFonts`)

### LittleBook

- **Path:** `apps/app/src/components/little-book/`
- **Purpose:** Scroll-driven 3D book (jh3y ExPVzBY) — GSAP ScrollTrigger page flips
- **Stories:** `Components/LittleBook`
- **Deps:** gsap + ScrollTrigger

The reference prototype includes a WeatheredClassifiedDocument variant. The target file is a simpler ClassifiedDocument with two cards. I'm beginning to plan the integration steps.

PhotoCaption will be self-contained with inline Tailwind styles for standalone use. ClassifiedDocument becomes a named export following folder conventions. PhotoCaption will support both block and absolute positioning via optional className. The export follows Prettier conventions without semicolons or single quotes. A standard img tag handles external blob URLs instead of Next.js Image.

Subcomponents will be extracted lightly while preserving source fidelity. The Card import path is confirmed.
